name: paul-trap-held
description: Published: the tabulated Mathieu ejection boundary for a 3-D quadrupole trap on the a = 0 line is q_z = 0.90804, and this model sits at q_z = 0.30. Held. q_z = 0.30, well inside every boundary in play - the tabulated 0.90804 and this geometry's own 0.822 - so the ion is still in the trap after two hundred RF cycles, having struck nothing and escaped nowhere.
